title: What mass spectrometry measures
summary: From molecules to ions to evidence: understand what a mass spectrum can—and cannot—tell you.
zh_summary: 从分子到离子，再到证据：理解质谱能够回答和无法单独回答的问题。

title: m/z, charge & isotopes
summary: Calculate charged-ion masses and build an isotope distribution, then connect both to measurement quality.
zh_summary: 计算带电离子的质量并构建同位素分布，再将二者与测量质量联系起来。

title: How molecules become ions
summary: Compare ESI, MALDI, EI, and APCI by the chemistry they enable—not by a universal ranking.
zh_summary: 根据电离过程与适用化学性质比较 ESI、MALDI、EI 和 APCI。

title: Mass analyzers & resolution
summary: Follow quadrupole filtering, TOF timing, ion trapping, and frequency measurement, then compare resolution and accuracy.
zh_summary: 理解四极杆过滤、TOF 计时、离子俘获与频率测量，再比较分辨本领与准确度。

title: Fragmentation & tandem MS
summary: Trace precursor isolation, compare activation methods, and interpret charge-aware product and neutral-loss evidence.
zh_summary: 跟踪前体隔离、比较活化方法，并结合电荷解释产物与中性丢失证据。

title: Read a spectrum step by step
summary: Read an annotated simulated spectrum: infer charge, inspect isotope ratios, and separate narrow peaks from accurate masses.
zh_summary: 解读带注释的模拟谱图：推断电荷、检查同位素比值，并区分窄峰与准确的质量测量。

title: Acquisition: full scan, DDA, DIA & targeted
zh_title: 采集：全扫描、DDA、DIA 与靶向
summary: Connect precursor selection, isolation windows, and chromatographic sampling to the evidence recorded by full scan, DDA, DIA, and targeted methods.
zh_summary: 把前体选择、隔离窗口与色谱采样联系起来，理解全扫描、DDA、DIA 和靶向方法保留的证据。

title: From raw data to reliable results
zh_title: 从原始数据到可靠结果
summary: Follow the evidence from spectral peaks to features, identity, and quantity, with explicit assumptions for error control, normalization, missing data, and study design.
zh_summary: 沿谱峰、特征、身份到定量追踪证据，明确错误控制、归一化、缺失数据和实验设计中的假设。
